answer: Each newcomer docks at the wharf with a sponsor locking 40 credits and 100 reputation. It is written on the willow ledger, exposing sponsors who back fakes. Each idle epoch strips 5 points off that reputation like wind off a dune; below 60 the seat is lost and 40 burn, so a rented ring dies at its first fraud. 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 locked plus 1,000 renewals an epoch against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps a full share.
